output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public returns (bool)
output_list.reason: The mintToken function is designed to mint more tokens to a specified address. However, it does not take into account the totalSupply. This can lead to the creation of more tokens than the total supply of the token. This can be exploited by minters to mint more tokens than the total supply of the token.
